correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the first i images leaves n-i path components whose random completion has expected H_(n-i) extra cycles. Counting completed k-cycles joint with a record gives the exact local covariance. The end-position and early-position contributions yield the stated first two asymptotic terms. An independent enumeration of all permutations for n=2..7 evaluated 27 rational local mixed moments and matched the formula exactly. This finite check corroborates but is not the all-n proof.
